headline: Here are the 25 original Xbox games you can now play on PC
summary: Microsoft brings 25 original Xbox games to PC. Available for digital copy holders. Marks Xbox's 25th anniversary.

headline: Microsoft Outlook is down
summary: Outlook users worldwide are reporting service outages. Microsoft acknowledges "elevated load" on infrastructure. Access issues affect both web and app users.

headline: Meet the people who want peptides to be made in America
summary: This article is from the "Optimizer" newsletter. It focuses on American manufacturing of peptides. Explores the push for domestic production of these compounds.

headline: No, AI agents did not discover a previously unknown Maya site
summary: A Google researcher falsely claimed AI discovered a new Maya site. The site was already discovered and published last year. Incident highlights issues with AI in archaeology.

headline: Lenovo Yoga 7i 16" 2-in-1 Laptop Drops to $650 for Black Friday
summary: Lenovo Yoga 7i 16" 2-in-1 laptop is on sale for $650. This convertible laptop is lightweight and ultra-portable. A Black Friday deal for students and professionals.

headline: Valheim Is Getting a Comic Book Series, and It Looks Badass
summary: Popular game Valheim is expanding into a comic book series. Features talent from Marvel, DC, and TV. The series promises an impressive and badass adaptation.

headline: Fable Drops Four Minutes of New Gameplay
summary: Xbox released four minutes of new Fable gameplay footage. The showcase provides more details on the game's combat. Fans get an extended look at the upcoming title.

headline: Ocarina of Time Remake ReDeads Were Originally Scarier
summary: Ocarina of Time Remake producer discusses toning down ReDeads. Originally, the creatures were designed to be even more frightening. Developers felt they "went a step too far" with the initial concept.

headline: Zoe Kleinman: How AI visionary Jensen Huang was undone by his own bad decisions
summary: Zoe Kleinman analyzes Jensen Huang's downfall. The Nvidia founder reportedly lost everything rapidly. His own bad decisions led to his undoing.

headline: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
summary: A Russian warship was struck by a Ukrainian drone. Attack occurred in the Gulf of Finland. First reported Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian ship in the open Baltic Sea.

headline: Microsoft users report outages amid tech giant 'connectivity issues'
summary: Microsoft users globally are experiencing outages. The tech giant reports "elevated load" on its infrastructure. Connectivity issues are affecting services worldwide.

headline: Can Burnham avoid another Labour welfare rebellion?
summary: Article discusses whether Burnham can prevent a Labour welfare rebellion. Forecasts a smaller revolt compared to Starmer's government. Explores internal party dynamics on welfare policy.
